messages:
Lucy: quick async check — prepping the runtime perf canary. Scope: kernel micro-op reorder, continuous-batching tweak, and KV cache eviction/metrics. Need clear owners, PRs to land, and any blockers. Reply with who owns what and blockers.

Amar: I can own the kernel micro-op reorder (PR #4620). I still need the evict heuristics merged first because my rebase depends on the api change. ETA for final patch: Tue EOD if evict PR lands.

Jordan: I own the evict heuristics work (PR #4618). Found a simulator timing flake on ppc64 tests; fixing the harness today. Expect CI green by Mon. Also added a unit test for the knob.

Sophie: I can add a prometheus exporter endpoint for kcache metrics, but we need infra mapping change so it gets scraped and uploaded to the canary dashboard. Can target Tue afternoon for infra PR if we bundle.

Kai: Heads-up: after the batching window tweak (PR #4599) my local long-seq runs show a 95th increase. I put perf traces and analysis in PR #4635 — suspect batching window interaction with KV warmup.

Lucy: For canary we require: (1) kcache hit-rate + TTL metrics available, (2) no tail-latency regressions on seq=512/1024, (3) perf snapshots uploaded. Please call out if you can't meet Tue EOD.

ci-bot: Canary tentative slot created: canary-2026-05-06-14:00 UTC. Sanity command: ```bash
make canary RUN_ID=canary-2026-05-06 MODEL=redwood-small SEQ=512
```
Will run smoke tests after merges.

Amar: PTAL on PR #4620: https://repo.internal/runtime/pulls/4620. Note: I adjusted kv-prefetch threshold slightly to avoid tiny batch churn. Need reviews from @Jordan and @Kai.

Jordan: Reviewing now, will post comments by EOD. Small request: can we get a trimmed ppc trace set for local repro? @Sophie?

Sophie: I will export sanitized ppc traces to s3://redwood-temp/ppc-samples by Mon 18:00 and open infra PR with prometheus mapping (PR #92). Dropping the link in this thread when ready.

Kai: Running perf harness against Amar's branch (seq=512, burst). Baseline 95th=40ms, branch 95th=51ms. Attaching logs to PR #4635. My immediate mitigation proposal: revert batching-window calc tweak and instead add a warmup-prefetch cap.

Lucy: Action summary: Amar = PR #4620 owner (rebase + final tweaks), Jordan = PR #4618 owner (evict heuristics & review), Kai = batching regression triage + perf artifacts, Sophie = infra metrics PR #92 + ppc traces. Target merges by Tue EOD so canary runs Wed. If any slippage call it out now.

Jordan: CI green for PR #4618 after ppc sim fix. Merging in a few minutes.

Amar: Rebased #4620 on top ofJordan's branch locally; pushing once CI passes. I'll add an extra perf snapshot to the PR.

Sophie: Infra PR #92 opened: prometheus scrape mapping + S3 uploader for kcache traces. Link: https://repo.internal/infra/pulls/92. I also created a shortplaybook for ops to enable extra logging during canary.

Kai: Re-ran perf harness after merges. New numbers: 95th=43ms (good improvement). Looks like the combination of the evict heuristics + Amar's prefetch tweak helped. I'll still collect full histograms during canary.

ci-bot: Canary scheduled: canary-2026-05-06-14:00 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/canary/canary-2026-05-06. Metrics to collect: kcache_hit_rate, kcache_ttl_hist, batching_window_ms, kv_warmup_pct, kernel_op_sched_latency.

Lucy: Thanks all. If canary shows any tail regressions we'll revert batching tweak and run a follow-up. Otherwise ops — please run the canary and collect the specified metrics. Reconvene here for any issues. :thumbsup:
